name: tombola
title: Tombola
description: A village fête theme whose programme is a strip of cloakroom raffle tickets — sugar-pink, mint, primrose and sky paper, each time stamped twice in numbering-machine figures either side of a perforation — beside plain black capitals on a white paper tablecloth, and the same pastel tickets on dusk grey after dark.

tokens.--font-body: all running text and the plain capital headings — an ordinary grotesque, as on a parish poster
tokens.--font-mono: the numbering-machine figures: times on the tickets, dates, and code in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing in capital headings, menu links, ticket titles and buttons
tokens.--color-bg: page background (the paper tablecloth by day, dusk grey at night) and the holes of every perforation
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the date label and the heavy rules
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: addresses, notes about people, post summaries, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, the invitation line, buttons, the current menu entry and focus rings (raspberry)
tokens.--color-rule: thin dividing lines: under the masthead, between facts, posts and table rows
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--color-paper-1: first ticket paper (sugar pink): every 1st, 5th, 9th ticket and person, and the bar beside a quotation
tokens.--color-paper-3: third ticket paper (primrose), also the colour of selected text
tokens.--color-print: the black ink on a ticket: times and titles, the same in both schemes
tokens.--color-print-soft: lighter ink on a ticket: the place and the note
tokens.--measure: width of the text column on pages, posts and the programme
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the masthead, home page and footer grow
tokens.--stub: narrowest a ticket stub with a time on it gets; where a programme part has no times its blank stubs are half as wide
tokens.--stub-max: widest a ticket stub grows to fit a long time; a longer one wraps inside it
tokens.--hole: diameter of a perforation hole, and the height of a dividing rule in page text
tokens.--perf: distance from one perforation hole to the next, on tickets, along the band at the top of the page and in a dividing rule in page text
tokens.--band: thickness of the four-paper band under page titles, above each person and beside a quotation; the band across the top of the page is twice as thick
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, code blocks, the search box and focus rings; tickets are cut square
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy black rules: beside a day heading, above lists, the card and the footer, under a menu entry and around the search box
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between the lines inside a ticket
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under labels and day headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the footer
